title: ActionObject
description: The single contract every adapter (web UI, Claude Code, CLI wrapper) speaks when submitting an agent-issued action to the Orion runtime core.

action_type.description: The kind of action being requested. Extend this enum (in lockstep on both sides) as new action types are needed.

target.description: The object being acted on: a file path, a branch name (for git_push), or a command string (for shell_exec).

adapter.description: Which of the three thin adapters submitted this action.

agent_name.description: The agent/model that issued the action, e.g. 'claude-sonnet-5'.

user.description: Identifier (email/id) of the human operating the adapter, if known. Phase 1 has no session persistence, so this is caller-supplied and unverified.

environment.description: Deployment environment context, used by the risk scorer.

metadata.description: Action-type-specific detail (diff, command string, file content hash, migration SQL, etc.). Freeform by design.
